verdict.rationale: Deel offers building blocks for background automation: webhooks push real-time event notifications so integrations can react without polling, and the API and MCP server let agents act on contracts, payroll and time-off. However, nothing in the evidence shows a native automation, workflow or scheduling feature that users can configure to run on its own. Any autonomous background behavior must be built and hosted externally by the user. Missing for 10: native automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous runs inside Deel, agent background-execution docs, independent corroboration.
